changelog:
⚡ What's New & Fixed in v1.7.6:

• 🎙️ Instant Background Wake Word: Upgraded Vosk recognizer with full acoustic vocabulary and continuous partial hypothesis decoding for immediate response in ambient room noise.

• ⚡ Lightning Hot-Standby: WebSocket transport pause eliminates reconnect delays, providing 0ms latency hands-free activation comparable to Gemini Live.

• 🧠 Zero Audio Clipping & Pre-Roll: Rolling 2-second pre-buffer captures full commands spoken immediately with the wake word (e.g. 'Hey Jarvis open Chrome').

• 🔊 Hardware AGC & Mic Processing: Automatic Gain Control (AGC) hardware effect enabled to amplify faint speech across the room.

• 👩 Aoede Default Voice: Aoede female voice is now the default voice for all users with seamless preference migration.

• 🤖 Smart Greeting Passthrough: Suppresses canned greetings when a direct command is spoken, delivering an ultra-smooth, natural conversation experience.
